# ZEL source and releases

The source repositories used by the current ZEL testnet are not public yet. Public source and release links will be added here when they are available. Until then, do not treat an unverified repository, branch, or commit as the source for a deployed ZEL release.

## Main implementation areas

- ZEL chain and protocol modules.
- EVM bridge and cross-chain contract components.
- Threshold-signing services and chain integrations.
- Constant-product AMM contracts.
- Price collection and oracle submission services.
- Lending protocol work, which remains in development.

## Evaluating a release

Record the repository, branch or tag, commit hash, build checksum, genesis or deployment identifier, contract addresses, ABI version, migration steps, and known issues. A merged pull request is not proof that a binary, contract, service, or testnet deployment uses that code.

For Zano L1 source and wallet tooling, see the [hyle-team organization](https://github.com/hyle-team) and the existing [Zano build documentation](/docs/build/overview).
